title: Large dinning hall in mansion and the trail in the woods outside the house
content: i painted these in 2022 but this dining hall was giving harry potter but one table, the outside of this room was like a castle almost. and as i stood there enjoying the peaceful night through all the glass windows around the room ropes and legs appeared in all the windows, fbi busted in every single window by dropping down off the ropes, they all yell stop put your hands up and i turn to run because i was scared of whoever they were after. When i turned to run they had surrounded me and told me to put my fing hands up and then i was shot and woke up. The other painting is of the trail outside if the mansion. I remember leaving the mansion through a small bedroom in the back's window, it lead me to this trail of candles in the woods and through the trees i could see a little girl jumping rope in the forest. i just remember walking the trail.
